jurisdiction.venue: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) & Rouse Avenue Court, New Delhi

headline: At India’s Serious Fraud Office, an Investigator Is Accused of Offering a Private Settlement Plan
deck: India’s C.B.I. arrested S.F.I.O. Deputy Director Harish Kumar Tanwar in an October trap case over an alleged ₹1 crore bribe demand tied to the DHFL probe.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Arrested in an October 2026 C.B.I. trap operation; the agency alleges a ₹1 Cr demand to favor a complainant in the S.F.I.O.’s DHFL probe. No charges proven; all three accused are presumed innocent.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the allegation would resemble a traffic constable pocketing a ₹2,000 roadside bribe
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Instant suspension and trap prosecution — here alleged inside India’s premier white-collar fraud agency

sources.title: CBI arrests SFIO official and two others in alleged ₹1 crore graft case

interactive_art_spec.caption: Shastri Bhawan in New Delhi, home to India’s Ministry of Corporate Affairs, where S.F.I.O. operates.
